cases.defense: Reject parent traversal that crosses a provider root.
Canonicalize WSL aliases without conflating Linux case-sensitive identity.
Do not follow symlinks, junctions, or reparse points outside an operation root.
Revalidate Windows local or WSL source file identity and rewrite metadata, provider boundary, destination containment, and collision at the mutation boundary.
Report exact completed effects when cancellation arrives during composite work.
Resolve case and normalization collisions through one explicit conflict decision.
Never delete a source after any composite-move copy or verification failure.
Reject permanent deletion without capability-bound explicit confirmation.
Use fixed non-shell WSL discovery arguments, validate distribution output, and prevent command injection through names and path text.
Prevent credentials and sensitive full paths from reaching diagnostics.
Bound and cancel hostile large or recursively changing Windows local and WSL enumerations.

Reject malformed, oversized, unknown-version, partially written, concurrently changed, or reparse-redirected settings; preserve the approved ancestor anchor, reject document reparse entries, freeze owned temporary identity from its open handle, revalidate exact destination and temporary bytes, and publish through the provider-atomic install.
Never interpret IME or text-editor input as Vim or destructive commands.
Reject duplicate and reentrant operation dispatch deterministically.
Reject Windows device names, ambiguous roots, invalid UNC shares, and unrepresentable provider entry segments.
Freeze source and destination identities when pane activation changes mid-operation.
Normalize Windows local and WSL permission or availability changes without widening access or retry scope.
Stop a batch before mutation when any source fails complete preflight or capability discovery.
